local FpsCamera = {}

function FpsCamera:init()
    -- Configuration
    self.sensitivity = 0.002
    self.moveSpeed = 5.0
    self.yaw = 0.0
    self.pitch = 0.0
    self.playerObj = nil

    -- Grab the camera component and set it up
    self.camera = Camera(self.scene, self.entity)
    self.camera:setPerspective(70.0, 1.778, 0.1, 1000.0)
    self.camera:disableTarget()  -- we will control the view directly
    self.camera:activate()

    -- Lock the mouse cursor
    Engine.mouseMode = MouseMode.LOCKED

    -- Register update callback (engine calls onUpdate)
    RegisterEngineEvent(self, "onUpdate")

    -- Mouse look handling
    Engine.onMouseMove = function(_, x, y)
        self.yaw = self.yaw - x * self.sensitivity
        self.pitch = self.pitch - y * self.sensitivity
        if self.pitch > 1.5 then self.pitch = 1.5 end
        if self.pitch < -1.5 then self.pitch = -1.5 end
    end
end

function FpsCamera:onUpdate()
    -- Lazy‑load the player object reference
    if not self.playerObj then
        local playerEntity = Engine.scene:findEntity("Player")
        if not playerEntity then return end
        self.playerObj = Object(self.scene, playerEntity)
    end

    -- Position the camera above the player
    local playerPos = self.playerObj.position
    self.camera.position = Vector3(playerPos.x, playerPos.y + 1.7, playerPos.z)

    -- Apply rotation from mouse look
    local q = Quaternion(self.pitch, self.yaw, 0.0)
    self.camera.rotation = q

    -- Movement (WASD) – apply to the player body if it has one
    local moveDir = Vector3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
    local forward = self.camera:getDirection()
    local right = self.camera:getRight()

    if Input.isKeyPressed(Input.KEY_W) then
        moveDir = moveDir + Vector3(forward.x, 0.0, forward.z)
    end
    if Input.isKeyPressed(Input.KEY_S) then
        moveDir = moveDir - Vector3(forward.x, 0.0, forward.z)
    end
    if Input.isKeyPressed(Input.KEY_A) then
        moveDir = moveDir - Vector3(right.x, 0.0, right.z)
    end
    if Input.isKeyPressed(Input.KEY_D) then
        moveDir = moveDir + Vector3(right.x, 0.0, right.z)
    end

    if moveDir:x() ~= 0.0 or moveDir:z() ~= 0.0 then
        -- Normalise and scale by speed
        local len = math.sqrt(moveDir.x * moveDir.x + moveDir.z * moveDir.z)

local FpsCamera = {}

function FpsCamera:init()
    self.sensitivity = 0.002
    self.moveSpeed = 5.0
    self.yaw = 0.0
    self.pitch = 0.0
    self.playerEntity = nil   -- will hold the player entity id
    self.playerObj = nil      -- Object wrapper for transform
    self.body = nil           -- Body3D wrapper for physics

    -- Camera setup (entity already has a CameraComponent)
    self.camera = Camera(self.scene, self.entity)
    self.camera:setPerspective(70.0, 1.778, 0.1, 1000.0)
    self.camera:disableTarget()   -- we will drive the view manually
    self.camera:activate()

    Engine.mouseMode = MouseMode.LOCKED

    -- Register engine callbacks
    RegisterEngineEvent(self, "onUpdate")        -- mouse look & camera positioning
    RegisterEngineEvent(self, "onFixedUpdate")   -- physics movement

    -- Mouse move handling (engine callback)
    Engine.onMouseMove = function(_, x, y)
        self.yaw = self.yaw - x * self.sensitivity
        self.pitch = self.pitch - y * self.sensitivity
        if self.pitch > 1.5 then self.pitch = 1.5 end
        if self.pitch < -1.5 then self.pitch = -1.5 end
    end
end

function FpsCamera:onUpdate()
    if not self.playerEntity then
        local ent = Engine.scene:findEntity("Player")
        if not ent then return end
        self.playerEntity = ent
        self.playerObj = Object(self.scene, ent)
        -- Get the existing Body3DComponent wrapper (may be nil if none attached)
        self.body = self.playerObj:getBody3D()
    end

    -- Position camera above the player
    local p = self.playerObj.position
    self.camera.position = Vector3(p.x, p.y + 1.7, p.z)

    -- Apply mouse look rotation
    local q = Quaternion(self.pitch, self.yaw, 0.0)
    self.camera.rotation = q
end

function FpsCamera:onFixedUpdate()
    if not self.body then return end

    -- Compute movement direction from input (horizontal plane only)
    local forward = self.camera:getDirection()
    local right   = self.camera:getRight()
    local moveDir = Vector3(0,0,0)

    if Input.isKeyPressed(Input.KEY_W) then
        moveDir = moveDir + Vector3(forward.x, 0, forward.z)
    end
    if Input.isKeyPressed(Input.KEY_S) then
        moveDir = moveDir - Vector3(forward.x, 0, forward.z)
    end
    if Input.isKeyPressed(Input.KEY_A) then
        moveDir = moveDir - Vector3(right.x, 0, right.z)
    end
    if Input.isKeyPressed(Input.KEY_D) then
        moveDir = moveDir + Vector3(right.x, 0, right.z)
    end

    if moveDir:x() ~= 0 or moveDir:z() ~= 0 then
        -- Normalise and scale by moveSpeed
        moveDir = moveDir:normalize() * self.moveSpeed
        self.body:applyForce(moveDir)
    end
end

return FpsCamera

    RegisterEngineEvent(self, "onUpdate")        -- mouse look & camera positioning
    RegisterEngineEvent(self, "onFixedUpdate")   -- physics movement

    -- Mouse move handling (engine callback)
    Engine.onMouseMove = function(_, x, y)
        self.yaw = self.yaw - x * self.sensitivity
        self.pitch = self.pitch - y * self.sensitivity
        if self.pitch > 1.5 then self.pitch = 1.5 end
        if self.pitch < -1.5 then self.pitch = -1.5 end
    end
end

function FpsCamera:onUpdate()
    if not self.playerEntity then
        local ent = Engine.scene:findEntity("Player")
        if not ent then return end
        self.playerEntity = ent
        self.playerObj = Object(self.scene, ent)
        -- Get the existing Body3DComponent wrapper (may be nil if none attached)
        self.body = self.playerObj:getBody3D()
    end

    -- Position camera above the player
    local p = self.playerObj.position
    self.camera.position = Vector3(p.x, p.y + 1.7, p.z)

    -- Apply mouse look rotation
    local q = Quaternion(self.pitch, self.yaw, 0.0)
    self.camera.rotation = q
end

    if not self.body then return end

    -- Compute movement direction from input (horizontal plane only)
    local forward = self.camera:getDirection()
    local right   = self.camera:getRight()
    local moveDir = Vector3(0,0,0)

    if Input.isKeyPressed(Input.KEY_W) then
        moveDir = moveDir + Vector3(forward.x, 0, forward.z)
    end
    if Input.isKeyPressed(Input.KEY_S) then
        moveDir = moveDir - Vector3(forward.x, 0, forward.z)
    end
    if Input.isKeyPressed(Input.KEY_A) then
        moveDir = moveDir - Vector3(right.x, 0, right.z)
    end
    if Input.isKeyPressed(Input.KEY_D) then
        moveDir = moveDir + Vector3(right.x, 0, right.z)
    end

    if moveDir:x() ~= 0 or moveDir:z() ~= 0 then
        -- Normalise and scale by moveSpeed
        moveDir = moveDir:normalize() * self.moveSpeed
        self.body:applyForce(moveDir)
    end

local FpsCamera = {}

function FpsCamera:init()
    self.sensitivity = 0.002
    self.moveSpeed = 5.0
    self.yaw = 0.0
    self.pitch = 0.0
    self.playerEntity = nil   -- will hold the player entity id
    self.playerObj = nil      -- Object wrapper for transform
    self.body = nil           -- Body3D wrapper for physics

    -- Camera setup (entity already has a CameraComponent)
    self.camera = Camera(self.scene, self.entity)
    self.camera:setPerspective(70.0, 1.778, 0.1, 1000.0)
    self.camera:disableTarget()   -- we will drive the view manually
    self.camera:activate()

    Engine.mouseMode = MouseMode.LOCKED

    -- Register engine callbacks
    RegisterEngineEvent(self, "onUpdate")        -- mouse look & camera positioning
    RegisterEngineEvent(self, "onFixedUpdate")   -- physics movement

    -- Mouse move handling (engine callback)
    Engine.onMouseMove = function(_, x, y)
        self.yaw = self.yaw - x * self.sensitivity
        self.pitch = self.pitch - y * self.sensitivity
        if self.pitch > 1.5 then self.pitch = 1.5 end
        if self.pitch < -1.5 then self.pitch = -1.5 end
    end
end

function FpsCamera:onUpdate()
    if not self.playerEntity then
        local ent = Engine.scene:findEntity("Player")
        if not ent then return end
        self.playerEntity = ent
        self.playerObj = Object(self.scene, ent)
        -- Get the existing Body3DComponent wrapper (may be nil if none attached)
        self.body = self.playerObj:getBody3D()
    end

    -- Position camera above the player
    local p = self.playerObj.position
    self.camera.position = Vector3(p.x, p.y + 1.7, p.z)

    -- Apply mouse look rotation
    local q = Quaternion(self.pitch, self.yaw, 0.0)
    self.camera.rotation = q
end

function FpsCamera:onFixedUpdate()
    if not self.body then return end

    -- Compute movement direction from input (horizontal plane only)
    local forward = self.camera:getDirection()
    local right   = self.camera:getRight()
    local moveDir = Vector3(0,0,0)

    if Input.isKeyPressed(Input.KEY_W) then
        moveDir = moveDir + Vector3(forward.x, 0, forward.z)
    end
    if Input.isKeyPressed(Input.KEY_S) then
        moveDir = moveDir - Vector3(forward.x, 0, forward.z)
    end
    if Input.isKeyPressed(Input.KEY_A) then
        moveDir = moveDir - Vector3(right.x, 0, right.z)
    end
    if Input.isKeyPressed(Input.KEY_D) then
        moveDir = moveDir + Vector3(right.x, 0, right.z)
    end

    if moveDir.x ~= 0 or moveDir.z ~= 0 then
        -- Normalise and scale by moveSpeed
        moveDir = moveDir:normalize() * self.moveSpeed
        self.body:applyForce(moveDir)
    end
end

function FpsCamera:init()
    self.sensitivity = 0.002
    self.moveSpeed = 5.0          -- units per second
    self.yaw = 0.0
    self.pitch = 0.0
    self.playerEntity = nil       -- Entity id of the player
    self.playerObj = nil          -- Object wrapper for the player
    self.body = nil               -- Body3D wrapper (for physics)

    -- Camera component is already present on this entity
    self.camera = Camera(self.scene, self.entity)
    self.camera:setPerspective(70.0, 1.778, 0.1, 1000.0)
    self.camera:disableTarget()   -- we'll drive view manually
    self.camera:activate()

    Engine.mouseMode = MouseMode.LOCKED

    -- Register callbacks
    RegisterEngineEvent(self, "onUpdate")        -- mouse look & camera placement
    RegisterEngineEvent(self, "onFixedUpdate")   -- physics movement

    -- Mouse move handling (engine forwards mouse deltas)
    Engine.onMouseMove = function(_, x, y)
        self.yaw   = self.yaw   - x * self.sensitivity
        self.pitch = self.pitch - y * self.sensitivity
        if self.pitch > 1.5 then self.pitch = 1.5 end
        if self.pitch < -1.5 then self.pitch = -1.5 end
    end
end

function FpsCamera:onUpdate()
    -- Resolve player once
    if not self.playerEntity then
        local ent = Engine.scene:findEntity("Player")
        if not ent then return end
        self.playerEntity = ent
        self.playerObj = Object(self.scene, ent)
        -- Retrieve existing Body3D component (may be nil if none attached)
        self.body = self.playerObj:getBody3D()
    end

    -- Keep camera positioned slightly above the player
    local p = self.playerObj.position
    self.camera.position = Vector3(p.x, p.y + 1.7, p.z)

    -- Apply mouse look rotation to the camera
    local q = Quaternion(self.pitch, self.yaw, 0.0)   -- Euler angles (engine uses degrees)
    self.camera.rotation = q
end

function FpsCamera:onFixedUpdate()
    if not self.body then return end

    -- Build a movement vector on the horizontal plane
    local forward = self.camera:getDirection()
    local right   = self.camera:getRight()
    local moveDir = Vector3(0,0,0)

    if Input.isKeyPressed(Input.KEY_W) then
        moveDir = moveDir + Vector3(forward.x, 0, forward.z)
    end
    if Input.isKeyPressed(Input.KEY_S) then
        moveDir = moveDir - Vector3(forward.x, 0, forward.z)
    end
    if Input.isKeyPressed(Input.KEY_A) then
        moveDir = moveDir - Vector3(right.x, 0, right.z)
    end
    if Input.isKeyPressed(Input.KEY_D) then
        moveDir = moveDir + Vector3(right.x, 0, right.z)
    end

    if moveDir.x ~= 0 or moveDir.z ~= 0 then
        moveDir = moveDir:normalize() * self.moveSpeed
        self.body:applyForce(moveDir)   -- centre force each physics step
    end
end

return FpsCamera
